incidents.narrative_text: Suspicious PowerShell with encoded payload blocked on workstation FIN-042; parent process explorer.exe; end user notified per playbook.
Outbound SMB sessions to an unusual internal subnet from legacy file server FS-09; connections reset; firewall rule review requested.
Repeated failed local admin logins on laptop HR-118 after hours; account disabled; device queued for reimage.
DNS tunneling-like query volume spike from guest Wi-Fi VLAN; sinkhole sink applied; no data exfil indicators in summary.
Ransomware-like file extension mass change not observed; high-confidence false positive from backup indexer; alert closed.
TLS to newly registered domain from DMZ web tier; WAF challenge enabled; SOC ticket linked to change window.
